required_nodes.rationale: Real production publisher custody is returned byte-for-byte and independently binds the actuator request and deterministic intent.
Authenticated fixed-custody loading performs only reads and invokes no lock or mutation primitive.
Receipt-last partial custody remains unpublished and fails closed.
Re-digested receipt tampering cannot substitute its deterministic-intent binding.
An independently re-digested false exact decoded-artifact SHA-256 binding is rejected.
An independently re-digested false deterministic-intent semantic binding is rejected.
Semantically equivalent textual rewrites of either durable object fail canonical custody.
The narrow API exposes no caller path, write, publication, execution, allocation, bundle, inference, signing, minting, or startup authority.
Current implementation verifies every frozen consumer item while preserving the historical machine artifact.
